# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 stable** · Released October 12, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.154.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m154 and modernizes packaged API documentation. The release also refreshes HarfBuzzSharp binding generation and includes upstream rendering fixes. Review the intentional HarfBuzzSharp enum changes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed** — HarfBuzz corrected the upstream constant name while retaining its numeric value. Replace references to CCC133 with CCC132.
- **GlyphFlags.Defined was removed** — The aggregate flag mask is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete glyph flags your code requires instead.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m154 and incorporates upstream buffer-upload, failed-flush cache, and other rendering fixes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114), [#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))

## API Surface

- **API documentation ships with packages** — Compiler-generated XML documentation is packaged alongside the managed assemblies, with public API remarks authored directly in C# documentation comments. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## Platform

- **RAW and DNG decoding disabled** — The release does not provide RAW or DNG image decoding; use a supported encoded image format when loading those assets. ([#5190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5190))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the HarfBuzz revision bundled by Skia, keeping supported APIs synchronized while excluding unsupported callback-heavy families.
